spec.studio_prompt: A modern minimalist rectangular dining table measuring 162 cm long, 89 cm wide, and 75 cm high. The top is a thick, rectangular slab of polished clear tempered glass with subtle grey reflections (#ceced1) and flat polished edges. The base is constructed from four straight, square-section steel legs and a clean perimeter support frame, all finished in a uniform matte powder-coated charcoal black (#393736). The glass rests cleanly and securely on the geometric, corner-positioned black metal structure.
